description: The Urza block — Urza's Saga (1998), Urza's Legacy (1999) and Urza's Destiny (1999): 621 distinct cards and 636 original English printings, 591 of them new to the game.
name: The Urza Block
rules_note: Original Urza's Saga, Urza's Legacy and Urza's Destiny artwork with current Oracle rules. The 30 cards the game already has (the five basic lands among them) keep their existing scripts; the 18 of them that live only in Ice Age, Portal, Portal Second Age or Mirage are provided by this pack too when that pack is off.
